description_en: Calls UpdateQualityRule to update the information of a quality check rule
description_zh: 调用UpdateQualityRule更新校验规则的信息
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public update-quality-rule --id 1234 --method-name table_count --project-name autotest --property id --project-id 26 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateQualityRule

parameters.help_en:
The strength of the quality check rule. The strength indicates the importance of the rule. Valid values:
1: strong rule.
0: weak rule.
You can set important rules as strong rules based on your business requirements. If a strong rule is used and a red alert is triggered, the scheduling task is blocked
parameters.help_zh:
校验规则的强弱。强弱表示规则的重要程度。取值如下：
1，表示强规则。
0，表示弱规则。
您可以根据实际需求设置重要的规则为强规则。如果使用强规则并触发了红色告警，则会阻塞调度任务
parameters.name: block_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the partition expression. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173995.html operation to obtain the partition expression ID
parameters.help_zh: 分区表达式的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173995.html接口获分区表达式ID
parameters.name: entity_id

parameters.example: Verify the number of table rows
parameters.help_en: The description of the quality check rule
parameters.help_zh: 校验规则的描述信息
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en:
The checker ID.
2: 7-day average fluctuation.
3: 30-day average fluctuation.
4: 1-day cycle comparison.
5: 7-day cycle comparison.
6: 30-day cycle comparison.
7: 7-day variance fluctuation.
8: 30-day variance fluctuation.
9: comparison with a fixed value.
10: 1-, 7-, and 30-day fluctuation detection.
11: previous cycle comparison.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173995.html operation to obtain the checker ID
parameters.help_zh:
校验器ID。
2，表示 7 天平均值波动。
3，表示 30 天平均值波动。
4，表示 1 天周期比较。
5，表示 7 天周期比较。
6，表示 30 天周期比较。
7，表示 7 天方差波动。
8，表示 30 天方差波动。
9，表示与固定值比较。
10，表示 1、7、30 天波动检测。
11，表示上一周期比较。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173995.html接口获取校验器ID
parameters.name: checker

parameters.help_en: The expected value of the check result
parameters.help_zh: 校验结果的期望值
parameters.name: expect_value

parameters.help_en: The ID of the quality check rule. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173995.html operation to obtain the rule ID
parameters.help_zh: 校验规则的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173995.html接口获取规则ID
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en:
The trend of the check result. Valid values:
up: upward trend.
down: downward trend.
abs: absolute value
parameters.help_zh:
校验结果的趋势。取值如下：
up，表示上升趋势。
down，表示下降趋势。
abs，表示绝对值
parameters.name: trend

parameters.help_en: The name of the method used to collect sample data. Valid values: avg, count, sum, min, max, count_distinct, user_defined, table_count, table_size, table_dt_load_count, table_dt_refuseload_count, null_value, null_value/table_count, (table_count-count_distinct)/table_count, and table_count-count_distinct
parameters.help_zh: 采集样本数据方法的名称。包括avg、count、sum、min、max、count_distinct、user_defined、table_count、table_size、table_dt_load_count、table_dt_refuseload_count、null_value、null_value/table_count、(table_count-count_distinct)/table_count、table_count-count_distinct等
parameters.name: method_name

parameters.help_en:
The comparison operator. Valid values: >, >=, =, ≠, <, and <=.

When Checker is set to 9, Operator is a required parameter
parameters.help_zh:
比较符。包括>、>=、=、≠、<和<=等。

当Checker=9时，Operator为必选参数
parameters.name: operator

parameters.help_en: The name of the engine or data source. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the workspace management page to obtain the name
parameters.help_zh: 引擎或者数据源的名称。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间管理页面获取名称
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the field
parameters.help_zh: 字段的名称
parameters.name: property

parameters.help_en: The type of the field
parameters.help_zh: 字段的类型
parameters.name: property_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the rule. Valid values:
0: system template rule.
1: custom SQL rule.
4: custom template rule
parameters.help_zh:
规则的类型：
0：系统模板规则
1：自定义SQL规则
4：自定义模板规则
parameters.name: rule_type

parameters.help_en: The filter condition or custom SQL statement used by the check task
parameters.help_zh: 校验任务使用的过滤条件或自定义SQL语句
parameters.name: where_condition

parameters.help_en: The red alert threshold. This value indicates the degree of deviation from the expected sample value. You can customize this threshold based on your business requirements. If a strong rule is used and the red threshold is triggered, the scheduling task is blocked
parameters.help_zh: 红色告警阈值。表示与样本预期的偏离程度。您可以根据业务需求自定义该阈值。使用强规则并触发红色阈值，会阻塞调度任务
parameters.name: critical_threshold

parameters.help_en: The orange alert threshold. This value indicates the degree of deviation from the expected sample value. You can customize this threshold based on your business requirements
parameters.help_zh: 橙色告警阈值。表示与样本预期的偏离程度，您可以根据业务需求自定义该阈值
parameters.name: warning_threshold

parameters.help_en: The ID of the check template. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173995.html operation to obtain the check template ID
parameters.help_zh: 使用的校验模板的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173995.html接口获取校验模板的ID
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the quality check rule
parameters.help_zh: 校验规则的名称
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the threshold is dynamic. Valid values:
0: non-dynamic threshold.
2: dynamic threshold
parameters.help_zh:
是否为动态阈值。取值如下：
0，表示非动态阈值。
2，表示动态阈值
parameters.name: predict_type

parameters.help_en:
The enabled or disabled status of the rule, which controls whether the quality rule runs in the production environment.

true: When the scheduling task associated with the output table data of the data quality rule is executed, the quality rule check is triggered.

false: When the scheduling task associated with the output table data of the data quality rule is executed, the quality rule check is not triggered
parameters.help_zh:
规则的启用或停用状态，用于控制质量规则是否在生产环境中运行。

true：在数据质量规则关联产出表数据的调度任务执行时，便会触发质量规则校验。

false：在数据质量规则关联产出表数据的调度任务执行时，不会触发质量规则校验
parameters.name: open_switch

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks项目空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The variable settings inserted before the custom rule, in the format of x=a,y=b
parameters.help_zh: 在自定义规则之前插入的变量设置，格式如：x=a,y=b
parameters.name: task_setting

Data.description_en: Indicates whether the quality check rule is updated
Data.description_zh: 校验规则是否更新成功

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于出现错误后排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful
